item.title: Week 10: 49ers at Cowboys
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 4:25 PM ET | Line: SF -4.5 · O/U 55.5 | Model DAL 42% vs. market 34% | On paper San Francisco has the edge (San Francisco ranks 5th in EPA per dropback, +0.25). Under center, Brock Purdy ranks 4th of 31 in EPA per dropback and Dak Prescott ranks 7th; x-factor: CeeDee Lamb gets 35% of Dallas' targets and 43% of its air yards, and San Francisco's pass defense ranks 6th. The model favors San Francisco at 58%, mostly on passing matchup (2.2 pts) and defensive injuries (0.7 pts).
